en: Your first companion. Swings a pitchfork with more grit than skill.
Plants his feet and takes the hits so others don't have to.
Calls out weak spots, speeding up the whole party.
Patches up the party with flour-dusted bandages.
Lobs shadow-laced stones that splash nearby foes.
Brews quick remedies from whatever grows nearby.
Fast, precise strikes against a single target.
Holds the line behind a long pike and a tower shield.
Weakens the enemy with poisons and dirty tricks.
Hits harder the longer the fight goes on.
Blends sword and spell into rapid critical strikes.
Curses and dark bolts that hit the whole field.
Calls down storms that crash over every enemy.
A burning shield that punishes whoever strikes it.
A legendary blade of dawn. Built around crits and speed.
Wears dragon scale and fears nothing. Built around DEF.
Channels starlight through living wood. Built around skill damage.
Sees the next blow coming and heals before it lands.
Bends time so the party acts first and acts more.
Tears open the void. Devastating, if she survives.
Soaks damage and protects the party.
Heals and keeps the party standing.
